for pdf_path in pdfs:
    print('='*80)
    print(f'FILE: {os.path.basename(pdf_path)}')
    print('='*80)
    try:
        with open(pdf_path, 'rb') as f:
            reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(f)
            print(f'Pages: {len(reader.pages)}')
            for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
                text = page.extract_text()
                if text:
                    print(f'--- Page {i+1} ---')
                    print(text)
